caseNameFull: R. C. Breen v. Morton Denison Hull
attorneys: Mr. íl. V. Mercer, with whom Messrs. H. B. Fryberger and Harvey Hoshour were on the brief, for plaintiffs in error. Messrs. Frank D. Adams, Elmer F. Blu, George W. Morgan, Nathan L. Miller and Kenneth B. Halstead were on the brief for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of a Federal question on the authority of Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Norton v. Whiteside, 239 U. S. 144, 147. The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
